## Description

Sells an at-the-money straddle and buys farther out-of-the-money wings to cap defined risk, benefiting if expiry stays near the center strike.

## Where it may fit

Range-bound underlying prices and high implied versus realized volatility, subject to limited payoff and gap risk.

## Vehicles

Options-income, volatility-risk-premium and defined-risk derivatives portfolios.

## Required data

Option chain by strike/expiry, implied vol, Greeks, underlying prices, bid/ask spreads, margin and event calendar.

## Caveats

Short gamma can cause rapid losses around jumps; defined maximum loss still may be large relative to credit received.
